attempts.input: Compare recent-updated sorting against this round’s own session timestamps; use manual sorting to reorder two round-owned sessions; reopen the project list; restore the original sort preference.
actual_steps: Read original updated sort value and top session order.
Changed to manual sorting using the visible sort menu.
Dragged first round-owned session below the second; observed order change.
Dragged it back to restore the original order.
Collapsed and reopened tpt-workspace while in manual mode; observed manual mode persisted.
Restored 最近更新 and observed the original order.
attempts.wait_condition: UI state updated immediately after each menu or drag action; no model wait.

checkpoints.expected: 最近更新排序与可观察更新时间对应
checkpoints.observed: With updated sort selected, newest round-created Expert session appeared before the Skill session (20:19 > 20:16) and the earlier task; the order matched observed creation/completion time.

checkpoints.expected: 手动排序的实际交互和结果有证据；不以合成拖拽失败判产品失败

checkpoints.expected: 记录重开后的持久性与原偏好恢复；未明确承诺的规则按实际行为留档
checkpoints.observed: Collapsed and reopened tpt-workspace while manual sort was selected; manual value and order remained. Restored the original 最近更新 preference and confirmed order.

attempts.observed_result: Recent-updated sort matched the two newest sample sessions; manual drag reordered them and the second drag restored them. Manual preference survived project-list collapse/reopen. Original updated preference restored.
attempts.notes: Only round-owned sessions were reordered; no user assets or session content changed.
